title: In the quiet hum of summer.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! Today, I'd like you to humor me and my "pointless thing"!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hah hah hah. What's wrong, Grease? What's the matter?
You haven't been able to stand back up since you drank the Spirit Water I gave you."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Kh... y-you...!! Why!!
We were supposed to be comrades who came this far together...... why!!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Oof, guess you're pretty much beat? Gonna give up?
Give up and make a Complete Contract with me?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"......So falling is the only option left...... for me...!
But that's the only...... road ahead——"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "Grease-samaaa. I adore you sooo. Ufufu."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"She's waiting in that town. Even now, she is.
I can't afford to fall until I make it back there!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here, the stage direction where, as if glass shatters, the mindscape breaks apart――
(Bariin! Baribari, baaariin!!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Wha... y-you... without a Complete Contract, how......!
W-well fine! I beg of you, Ryuha-Oh-sama!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um, me, right? Ahem――
"Are you going to teach me? The taste of defeat?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Hear me, you fiends, and remember.
I am the one who will one day...... annihilate you—— and erase the nightmare of this world——"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Imaginary-Number Hunter."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......I... I did it. I did iiit!
Hell yeahhh, I pulled it offff!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your cooperation! Thanks to you, I memorized all of the protagonist's lines from volume one of Imaginary-Number Hunter Grease!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ufufu. That was wonderful. I was checking on my tablet, and there was not a single mistake.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... this work hasn't been adapted to video, so I figured, then I'll do it myself!
Reciting it and acting out the scenes...... it was fun, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even though I didn't gain anything out of it——
Somehow, the satisfaction is huge!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahah☆ I mean, we were having fun doing it too!
Next time let's get costumes and stuff together too, not just the lines☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now then. Isn't it about time it was your turn——Ai? Getting dragged into stuff all the time, you must be sick of it by now, no? Don't you have anything you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Eh...? Me? Something I want to do......
Nothing of any deep meaning...... ...............

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......Ah! I want to go to the amusement park where Kyuumaru is!
Let's all go together!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm... that's not it, is it? That's a meaningful day off, isn't it? Going somewhere that "entertains you" on a day off is totally normal, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Don't you have something more pointless, but that you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
M-more pointless...? Mmm...!
...Special training to land a sextuple-unders jump twenty times...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Still not there. More! More!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Umm... a staring contest! I want to get better at staring contests! That training!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's all you've got!? You can do way better!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: B-but even if you say that...! I can't think of anything else anymore! Any further and I won't be able to do anything at all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah. Then isn't it fine to do nothing?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Eh!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(The me looking down on my present self is shouting at the top of her lungs......
"What on earth are you doing!?")

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (I should be training, whittling myself down to the bone. There's no time to be standing still. I know that——)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the Puchipla brand I like just dropped new shades!
Gonna tap buy♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Pandora-sama. The word sounds vaguely familiar, but what exactly is "puchipla"?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Eh, Bright-senpai, you don't know? Puchipla's like, cheap-but-super-nice-feeling makeup and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I see, is that so. I was quite sure it was some kind of famous regional sweet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Macaron-ish? "Puchipla" is definitely a bite-sized sweet.
We should get them to stock it in the Tracen Academy store, too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Tossing my body onto the bed and listening to everyone's voices......
I don't know why, but...... little by little, little by little......)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Um! Speaking of which, I was thinking it'd make a pretty good four-panel manga title! "Puchipla!".

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Probably there's a club for studying makeup — an "Oshare Club," and the heroines who belong to it do, like, stuff, or don't!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Eh, what's that, I wanna read it! Plus, "puchipla" in hiragana is, like, super cute, no? Might even be a name I'd give a puppy☆

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That really is a bit......——ah, but wait? If you gave a nickname like "Puu-chan," I feel like that'd be cute. Yeah, might be cute!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Somehow, I've started having fun. Everyone's voices are pleasant.
I'm...... thinking that I want to join in, too......)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Getting that impression — is it because "papipupepo" sounds so cute?
Bright-san, could you say it for us?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
??? I simply say it, then? ——
Papipupepo♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: See, cute.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Ahah. No, it's not the sound of the word or anything — it's simply that Bright-san herself is adorable.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...By the way. To confess, when I was a child, I thought "puchipla" meant "small tempura."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So "petit tempura," huh? Ahaha, I bet a shop like that exists. Next time, let's have the President take us to a shop that serves freshly-fried "puchipura."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Having utterly pointless conversations. Keeping them going.
That "meaninglessness" was hopelessly comforting——)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Could it be...... that this is it, I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Pandora-san, Kiseki-chan......

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's up?
Wanna eat some popcorn? It's good, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It can wait till tomorrow, but could you humor me a little?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hahh, hahh, hahh......
How is it!? What's the time!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah. Yeah... Ai-chan——
you're right, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It hasn't changed at all!
